errors.evidence: The description for the "Търговия" (Trade) line over-generalizes its behavior between 2011 and 2014. The line shows a visible fluctuation, rising from ~2.5 in 2011 to ~3.5 in 2012 and then falling back to ~2.5 in 2013, which is not captured by the phrase "a section without sharp changes".
